name: Nadab
overview: Nadab was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Jeiel and Maacah. His lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 8:30, which situates him within the genealogical records of Israel. Beyond his parentage and tribal affiliation, no additional details are provided about his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name Nadab is a proper name meaning 'volunteer' or 'free will offering.' This meaning highlights a sense of willing dedication or commitment, though the name itself was not given by God. The biblical reference for this name is found in 1 Chronicles 8:30.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Nadab as the son of Jeiel, establishing a direct father-son relationship. No other family relationships or descendants are mentioned beyond this connection in 1 Chronicles 8:30.
scriptureSignificance: Nadab's significance in the biblical narrative rests primarily on his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Benjamin. His mention in 1 Chronicles 8:30 contributes to the preservation of Israel's tribal and familial history, which is vital for understanding God's covenantal promises to His people. Although no further narrative details are provided, his inclusion underscores the importance of lineage in God's unfolding plan.
